description.value: The Tower Inn is described as the finest full-service hotel in Quesnel, located in the heart of the historic Cariboo Gold Rush country. It was selected as the overnight stop for the Rocky Mountaineer train on its Whistler-to-Jasper route, reflecting its standing as the city's premier lodging option. Touring cyclists staying here are a short walk from downtown shopping, restaurants, and local attractions.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and is detailed. The site confirms the address, phone, and email match OSM exactly. No mention of bike storage, bike rooms, tools, pump, or any cycling-specific services anywhere on the site. Confirmed amenities from the /amenities page include same-day laundry, vending machine, free Wi-Fi, on-site restaurant/bar (Begbie's Bar and Bistro serving dinner), and a 24-hour business centre. OSM name is 'Tower Inn & Suites' but the website consistently uses 'Tower Inn' without '& Suites'.
concerns: OSM name is 'Tower Inn & Suites' but the website consistently uses 'Tower Inn' without '& Suites' — possible name discrepancy.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operational full-service hotel in downtown Quesnel with a functioning website, confirmed contact details, and a range of guest amenities useful to touring cyclists.

Laundry.detail: Same-day laundry service and same-day dry cleaning listed in hotel amenities on /amenities page

Nearby evening food.detail: On-site Begbie's Bar and Bistro serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner with seating for up to 70 people

Vending machines.detail: Vending machine listed in hotel amenities on /amenities page

wow_evidence: selected as the overnight stop for the Rocky Mountaineer train on its Whistler-to-Jasper route

price.label: Mid-range
price.signal: Quesnel's premier full-service hotel (Rocky Mountaineer stop) but local market caps at $150-190
